description: Configuration for NFL Draft Advisory Board system and early declaration decisions
note_enabled: Feature flag to enable/disable advisory system. When false, falls back to simple rating-based declaration.

nfl_advisory_grades.description: Advisory grade thresholds and expected declaration rates by tier
nfl_advisory_grades.note: Grades represent NFL Draft Advisory Board evaluation of player draft stock

1st_round.description: Elite prospects projected as first round picks
1st_round.note: 95% of first-round prospects declare (Zion Williamson, Trevor Lawrence types)

2nd_round.description: Strong prospects projected as second round picks
2nd_round.note: 80% declare, some stay to improve stock (high-level starters)

3rd_day.note: 45% declare, many stay to develop (borderline prospects)

return_to_school.description: Below draft threshold, advised to return to school
return_to_school.note: 15% still declare (financial pressure, overconfidence, bad advice)

agent_influence.description: Agent contact probability and influence on declaration decisions
agent_influence.note: Agents push borderline players to declare, sometimes resulting in undrafted free agents
agent_influence.description_threshold: Minimum rating for significant agent interest
agent_influence.description_boost: Additional 15% declaration probability when agent involved

agent_quality_tiers.description: Agent quality affects advice quality (future enhancement)

standard.note: Standard agents sometimes overestimate player stock

fringe.note: Fringe agents often push players to declare prematurely

agent_influence.note: Agent quality tiers are defined but not yet implemented in Phase 8

decision_factors.description: Weights for multi-factor declaration decision model
decision_factors.description_financial: Financial pressure can override low grade (25% weight)
decision_factors.description_injury: Injury risk increases urgency to declare (20% weight)
decision_factors.description_upside: Low upside encourages declaring now (30% weight)
decision_factors.description_grade: Advisory grade is primary factor (25% base weight)
decision_factors.note_weights: Weights are additive modifiers to base declaration rate, not standalone probabilities

return_to_school_boost.description: Benefits and risks for players who return to school for senior year
return_to_school_boost.description_bonus: 15% faster attribute development for returning players
return_to_school_boost.description_hype: Hype decays slower for returning high-profile players (80% retention)
return_to_school_boost.description_injury_risk: 15% chance of significant injury per additional year (handled by PlayerLifecycle)
return_to_school_boost.note: Development bonus applied via development_context.usage multiplier

financial_need_mapping.description: Socioeconomic status to financial need mapping (used by _calculate_financial_need)
financial_need_mapping.note: High financial need increases declaration probability regardless of grade
financial_need_mapping.description_family: Large families (6+) add 0.1 to financial need

injury_risk_calculation.description: Formula for calculating injury risk factor from player history
injury_risk_calculation.note: High injury risk makes players more likely to declare (fear of career-ending injury)
injury_risk_calculation.description_count: Each injury adds 12.5% risk (capped at 0.5 for 4+ injuries)
injury_risk_calculation.description_severity: Average severity contributes up to 0.3 to risk score
injury_risk_calculation.description_major: Any major injury (severity >= 3.0) adds 0.2 to risk
injury_risk_calculation.note: Risk score clamped to 0.0-1.0, used to boost declaration probability

development_upside_calculation.description: Formula for calculating player development potential
development_upside_calculation.note: Low upside players benefit less from staying, so they're more likely to declare
development_upside_calculation.description_age: Younger players have more upside (age 20 = 1.0, age 25 = 0.0)
development_upside_calculation.description_ceiling: Room to grow to potential ceiling (future enhancement)
development_upside_calculation.note: Currently uses age-based upside only. Ceiling-based calculation planned for future.

backward_compatibility.description: Fallback to original simple declaration logic when advisory system disabled
backward_compatibility.note: Preserves existing behavior for testing and transition
backward_compatibility.note_formula: chance = base_chance + (rating - threshold) * bonus_per_point, clamped to 0.0-0.95

integration_notes.note_1: Called from CollegeSeason for junior players (college_year == 3)
integration_notes.note_2: Advisory grade stored in player.declaration_advisory for draft evaluation
integration_notes.note_3: Return bonus applied via player.development_context.usage multiplier
integration_notes.note_4: RNG consumption: 2 randf() calls per eligible player (agent contact + declaration)
integration_notes.note_5: Optional Phase 6 integration: Hype boosts agent contact probability
